content.text: {"schema_version":"1.0","material_cas":"7440-55-3","cases":[{"case_id":"2022_ukraine_conflit","title_fr":"Invasion de l'Ukraine : arrêt probable de la production primaire ukrainienne de gallium","event_type":"armed_conflict","first_report_date":"2022-02-24","end_date":"unknown","place":"Ukraine","country_iso2":"UA","node_type":"country","affected_commodities":["gallium brut"],"capacity_share_pct":null,"capacity_share_basis":"unknown","direction":"tightening","duration_days":null,"summary_fr":"L'USGS indique que l'Ukraine a très probablement cessé sa production primaire de gallium en 2022 à cause du conflit.
